content.headline: Everything you might ask before the call.
content.body: If something is missing, write to studio@halcyon.co.

faqs.q: How long does an engagement take?
faqs.a: Sprint: one week. Atelier: six weeks. Studio retainer: ongoing, month to month.

faqs.q: Do you work with early-stage founders?
faqs.a: Often. We reserve a portion of our calendar for first-time founders with strong taste.

faqs.q: What stack do you build on?
faqs.a: Next.js, GSAP, and our internal motion grammar — handed off cleanly so your team can extend it.
Berlin and remote. We work across CET, GMT, and ET timezones.

faqs.q: Can you ship faster than six weeks?
faqs.a: Sometimes. The Sprint engagement is designed for that.
